bias.en: Rebound · back above the 30-day, under the 200-day and $388
bias.zh: 反弹 · 重回 30 日均线上方，仍低于 200 日均线和 $388

read.en: Tesla rose 5.5% on Nov 9 to $378.05, trading $360.02–382.15. It is above the 5-day ($372.7), 30-day ($377.1) and 100-day ($366.6) and below the 10-day ($388.2) and 200-day ($383.5); all five averages are falling. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5, still above zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 ($407.55), and RSI is 50.
read.zh: 特斯拉 11月9日上涨 5.5%，收于 $378.05，盘中区间 $360.02–382.15。股价位于 5 日（$372.7）、30 日（$377.1）和 100 日均线（$366.6）上方，10 日（$388.2）和 200 日均线（$383.5）下方；五条均线均在下行。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴上方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看空（$407.55），RSI 为 50。

read.en: The rally broke both nearest resistances, $366.6–368.1 (100-day, Oct 19 close) and $372.7–377.9 (5 and 30-day), now support. Resistance is $382.2–383.5 (Nov 9 high, 200-day), then $388–388.6 (10-day, Oct 9 high, $388 cap) and $407.5–414.2 (SAR, Nov 2 high). Support is $372.7–377.1, then $366.6–368.1 and $345.9–349.3. A close above $383.5 would target $388; below $372.7, $366.6–368.
